name: lying single leg hamstring stretch against wall
description: Lie by a wall and rest one leg up against it to stretch the hamstring. Easy to relax into and good after leg days.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest one heel on the wall with your leg as straight as feels comfortable.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Relax and breathe, letting the hamstring lengthen.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
